name: Robert Lord — children James and Betsy in the 1911 Rochdale census
researcher_question: Is the Robert Brierley enumerated at Rochdale in 1911 with wife Ellen and children James and Betsy the same man as Robert Lord (b. 1858, son of Abel Brierley), and did he have those two children?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 9, hint-samples.csv row 332, flags adds_son/adds_daughter/adds_marriage, confidence 3). Draft transcribed from the 1911 England and Wales census household; unverified. Turns on whether the tree's 'Robert Lord' is Robert Brierley.
